# Upstream example contracts

These files are unmodified copies of the example data contracts in
`docs/examples/` of the Open Data Contract Standard repository:

- Repository: https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard
- Tag: `v3.2.0` (commit `f0bdad95346905d500be5ef4b2c2d9b1d95223b7`)

The tests check that every file validates against the schema, parses,
round-trips through `Marshal` and has no lint errors.
